title: Jude and the Confession
author: Sable Okafor
blurb: Bram Pemberton, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
